headline: Resident input process before Medford High School (MHS) project cost estimates, plus presentations on the project's needs and design.
summary: The meeting will cover a resolution on how residents can give input before MHS project cost estimates are presented on February 2nd. It also includes two presentations on the project and a resident question and answer session.
items: Resident input process before MHS project cost estimates on February 2nd
Educational plan and needs for the MHS project
Design and construction of the MHS project
location: City Council Chamber, 2nd Floor, Medford City Hall, 85 George P. Hassett Drive, Medford, MA and via Zoom
